dedupe_keys.name: axes de rues vitesses maximales liege

description: Axes de rues - Vitesses maximales - Liège is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Liège. Le jeu de données présente les limitations de vitesse par axe de circulation sur le territoire de la Ville de Liège. Ces données sont fournies à titre indicatif et ne peuvent en aucun cas se substituer au marquage au sol et aux panneaux de signalisation qui font autorité conformément au code de la route. Coverage: Liège. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are mobilité, zone 30. The portal shows 6,818 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-08-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
